keyPhrases.text: Funny, thrill-filled, and overflowing with song and dance
more loud than melodic, the latter more busy than beat-worthy
sure to draw an enthusiastically eager audience
seem to know precisely what to do
just another mediocre effort without the spectacular flying machine
deserves the waves of applause it garners
let's just say that it gets by

reasoning: Mixed review with both praise and criticism. Acknowledges spectacle and performances work well, but criticizes score as merely adequate and overly amplified. Generally favorable but with significant reservations about key elements.
